name: phase1-v2: CPU workers with the Qwen non-thinking preset and loop guards
why: In the phase-1 gate the CPU workers (presence_penalty 0, no opencode loop guard) looped in 2 of 3 arm-B capacity attempts; the GPU alias (router-injected presence_penalty 1.5) never looped. The Oct-5 A/B that dropped presence_penalty used a turn-capped (18) eval that could not show loops.

changes_vs_gate.worker_sampling: add --presence-penalty 1.5 (default 64-token window, same as the GPU alias); all other worker flags unchanged
changes_vs_gate.opencode: agent steps: workers 30, coordinator 40; permission doom_loop: deny (default 'ask' could hang a headless run)
changes_vs_gate.unchanged: model, quantisation, worker_flags, 32 GB VMs, task set (manifest 9415ec68...), coordinator alias qwen3.8-nothink, probe, thresholds

verified_before_registration: opencode 1.18.34 honours agent `steps`: a looping stub made exactly 4 / 12 calls then stopped (advisory: tools stay offered)
opencode doom_loop fires only on 3 identical tool calls within one assistant message, so it cannot catch one-call-per-turn loops

runs.quality: 3 Polyglot python runs, one per worker (index 04), --threads 1, same ruler as the gate
runs.capacity: 3 arm-B runs (B-v2 1..3), workers cold-restarted per run, host in arm-b layout

metrics.loop_signature: per worker log: longest run of consecutive requests with identical gen_n; >= 3 counts as a loop episode
metrics.step_limit_hits: worker sessions whose final task output follows the 'maximum number of steps' message
metrics.throughput: tasks/hour, passed/6, coordinator probe p50 vs baseline B 0.311 s

pre_registered_reading.loops_fixed: 0 loop episodes and 0 invalid runs across the 3 B-v2 capacity runs
pre_registered_reading.quality_not_hurt: v2 worker pass@2 mean within 1 task (2.9 pts) of the gate's worker mean 0.627
pre_registered_reading.capacity: compared descriptively with A1 (99.2 tasks/h, 6/6) and B1 (48.5 tasks/h, 4/6); the formal 5.7 rule needs 3 A runs and is NOT evaluated by v2
